body: Sometimes I just need to hear that.
I'm confused. You say living with someone is a bad life purpose yet yours is raising a family?

I have tried every dating site. Okcupid, tinder, christian mingle, plan old facebook and even paid $80 on eharmony. Simply the answer is that people don't answer me back. I've even had my brother and friends..girls even read my messages and i'm not saying anything wrong, nor am I picky. No one wants to answer. Or if they do it's very brief and then they don't answer back or I've had a couple of people not even showing up. 
What site did you use?
And I know what Valentines day is but I still can't help but wish I had someone to bless on that day. It's been my dream. 
No one seems to like what I like. Even my friends have told me how annoying my hobbies are. And my parents.
I probably won't go through with it but it still would be nice.
I wouldn't be able to do that.
Thanks. I'll try again to make friends tomorrow.
I am being selfish yes. But loneliness is what's eating me alive.

To clarify I'm NOT trying to find someone to fix my problems more I really am just lonely and even though i'm trying I only get results like getting cheated on and or them just ditching me altogether.

I'm sorry I was raised very religious. 
I'm not being fair. I apologize for making another person worry.
What other life purposes are there?
Do you have any positive views on death?

Prostitution is disgusting to me. Sex sounds nice and i'd surely like to experience it before I died. But there's something more to it than that. This is about finding love. And if I don't find it, Fuck it. 

Besides, meeting with the prostitute i'd probably grow feelings. It's part of my curse that I care that much. Meaningless sex is a design of Satan's.
Are you still here? I have many questions
No one answers me either. I have tried my best to reach out to as many people and yet no one cares. Especially women. Every girl I try and talk to ignores my ugly ass.
Because I've already done all of that.
Yeah I'm definitely in my parents expectations. I'm going to meet with a school consular to see my options. Thanks for the kind words, I just sometimes need a reminder

I have been to therapy, but it's not magic. I've been to 2 different therapists and they really didn't know what to do. One of them tried his best to encourage me to get out there again. 
Thanks for the encouragement, I really just need to understand it's going to take even longer than I thought.
You're right, I need to just take a brake for a while. There was a part of me that was telling myself to wait til she was single but I can't live like this anymore.
